name: VET Student Loans
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: A Commonwealth loan that pays tuition for approved diploma, advanced diploma and some graduate VET courses, repaid through the tax system.
key: 2026 maximum loan caps: Band 1 $6,428, Band 2 $12,858, Band 3 $19,290, and $96,467 for specific (Schedule 2) courses.
who: Only available for approved courses at diploma, advanced diploma, graduate certificate and graduate diploma level listed in the VET Student Loans (Courses and Loan Caps) Determination 2016.
Your provider must assess you as academically suited to the course.
how: Complete the Request for a VET Student Loan (eCAF) on or before the first census day you want the loan to cover.
catches: You can't borrow more than the loan cap for your course.
VET Student Loans count toward your overall HELP loan limit ($129,883 for most students in 2026).
You repay the debt through the tax system once your income passes the repayment threshold.
The department's 2024 information booklet says full-fee-paying students incur a 20 per cent loan fee and state-subsidised students don't. Check with your provider whether this still applies.

source.label: DEWR: News for VSL providers (2026 loan caps)

evidence.claim: Caps apply from census days in 2026
evidence.quote: These will apply to all units of study (new and continuing VSL students) with a census day of 1 January 2026 or later.
VET Student Loans are only available for approved courses at the diploma, advanced diploma
You must have been assessed by your course provider as academically suited to undertake the course
You must submit the eCAF on or before the first census day for which you would like the loan to apply.
Full fee paying/fee for service students will incur a 20 per cent loan fee on their VET Student Loan.
